THE IMPORTANCE OF INNOVATION
o Do something new that your competitors are not doing!
o Vital Importance: Never stand still - stay ahead of your competitors to help your business
succeed
o When competitors try to copy you, think of new ideas to ensure your business remains unique!
o To be innovative you need to identify new business opportunities!

THE IMPORTANCE OF INNOVATION
EXERCISE
Instruction:
In groups of 4 identify how you can identify a business opportunty.
Include all forms of research you can think of as well as ways of coming up with
ideas yourself.
This step is just about HOW you come up with an idea, don’t try to evaluate it,
that comes at a later stage.
WHAT YOU NEED TO DO Be Creative
Self-Starting
Actively reasearch and brainstorm ideas, look at the needs in the market and where other
solutions can be improved on
Avoid "me too" ideas unless you are offering something unique Generate NEW ideas!
Think outside the box. Don't let your current knowledge limit your thoughts
Future-Oriented
Avoid keeping things the same. Think about what might be needed in the future
Think of a way to record the creative ideas you want to pursue in the future
Overcoming Barriers
Don’t give up on ideas because you aren’t sure if they are feasible
Don’t allow tradition or convention to get in your way

THE "SCAMPER" TECHNIQUE
THE "SCAMPER" TECHNIQUE
Example: A Notepad
S - Substitute
C - Combine
A - Adapt
M - Modify
E - Eliminate
R - Rearrange
Replace paper with recycled materials or waterproof synthetic paper for
durability and eco-friendliness.
Combine the notepad with a calendar and planner, integrating
sections for scheduling and to-do lists.
Adapt the notepad for specific professions, such as adding templates
for designers, engineers, or chefs to cater to their unique needs.
Modify the cover design to be customizable with personal photos or
artwork, appealing to individual tastes.
Eliminate the need for a separate bookmark by integrating a ribbon
or elastic band marker.
Rearrange the order of pages to include sections for different
purposes (notes, tasks, ideas) within one notepad.
P – Put to another
use
Repurpose the notepad as a sketchbook by using thicker,
higher-quality paper suitable for drawing and painting.
Instruction:
Work in groups of two (02) and choose a product or service from one of your projects. Can you modify it
using the SCAMPER technique?
